rationale: RowDeletion was read in full. UnitVector and UnitRows use the full Euclidean sum of squares; RowValue is the ordinary real dot product. RetainedCount floors the real product theta*m.

SubsingularSquared ranges over every finite row subset of the exact retained cardinality and every unit vector. This is the square of the attained variational minimum on the positive-dimensional target domain. Empty retained sets and zero singular values are included. OperatorSquared takes the genuine complete unit-sphere squared-energy supremum.

UniformSphere normalizes actual Euclidean volume.toSphere by its ENNReal mass. The pinned HaarToSphere definition and finite/nonzero mass results were inspected; for positive n the normalized law is the uniform surface probability, including the two-point sphere in dimension one. No artificial measurable space or support-only uniformity condition occurs.

MatrixLaw is the full finite product of the same UniformSphere law, fixing independence. SampleMatrix extracts the actual Euclidean coordinates via WithLp.ofLp, so every row is a unit vector with that concrete law.

GaussianQuantile uses gaussianReal with mean zero and variance one, inspected in the pinned source. TrimmedMoment is the exact real integral with factor 1/sqrt(2*pi), integrand t^2*exp(-t^2/2), and endpoints -a,a. Since a>0, the oriented interval integral agrees with the source integral; endpoints have zero measure.

OriginalLimitTarget quantifies every allowed theta and exact positive quantile a, every pair of positive dimension sequences, and both n->infinity and m/n->infinity before every positive epsilon. Its event uses epsilon<=absolute ratio error and its measure tends to zero in ENNReal; no cross-dimension coupling or extra aspect-ratio growth condition appears.

QuantitativeAnswerTarget retains m>=1,n>=2 and all strict/weak parameter endpoints. Literal expressions for L,D,E,F and B match the approved source constants and formulas, including 512,5, the n powers, L/m and 1-t.

The bad event is the union of strict exceedances for normalized sSq and for the squared ratio. This is exactly the common exceptional-event bound; it is not an intersection or separately counted pair of probabilities.

Target conjoins the original limit and the separately credited stronger quantitative answer. Both named components independently have #assert_statement and #assert_trust kernel checks, preserving the original proposition as its own boundary.

Live/frozen source bodies were mechanically compared, allowing only the standard comment and namespace rename. The shared RowDeletion and Infrastructure modules, all pins, notes and full original source/specification are bound through the actual local import closure.

The retained fresh author-local root macOS receipts report successful shared/live/frozen compilation and actual rfl identity checks. Logs report only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. This reviewer inspected the evidence and definitions; it did not independently run Lean or Linux Comparator. No catalog proposition is proved by the statement declaration.
